metadata.description: The maintenance queue of a documentation package by its CURRENT state (PROP-057 `##OBS-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS`, `MAINTENANCE.md` §3 and §7). It holds no comparison with «since last time»: coverage gaps, unresolvable citations, adaptation divergences, page age, documentation debt and the linter's tally are all questions about the tree as it stands, because a version is a behavioural contract and the product inside one changes invisibly by design (`##OBS-VERSION-CONTRACT`). `vibe doc todo --format md` renders the week's report from it and `--format json` carries the eight numbers of the monthly review. It is a MEASURER and never a ratchet: the command prints the numbers and returns success whatever they say (`##OBS-NO-RELEASE-LOCK`). Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/doc_todo/`.
The documentation package's `<group>/<name>@<version>` coordinate.

Whether this run executed the documented examples. Running them builds a sandbox per fixture and costs minutes, so the queue leaves them to `--examples`; when it is false the example rows are ABSENT rather than zero, and the flag is here so nobody reads an unmeasured queue as a clean one.
The queue itself, grouped by where the work came from. A section with nothing in it is still emitted: «no unresolvable citations» is an answer, and a missing section reads as a check nobody ran.

The eight numbers of the monthly review (`MAINTENANCE.md` §7), in the order the table lists them. A number this run could not measure is `null` and never zero: «nothing to find» and «nothing looked» must not print the same digit.
Queue rows from coverage, examples and citations together — the first metric, and the one that should go to zero.
Median days since a page was last read aloud, from `reviews.toml`. `null` when the package records no readings at all — a manual nobody has read aloud yet has no median, it has a backlog.

How far the adaptations are from their source, counted as STRUCTURAL divergences — pages, anchors and blocks that do not mirror. The seventh edition removed the revision count this row used to hold, because «how far behind» needs a history the project does not keep (`##LOC-NO-REVISION`). `null` when the package adapts nothing.
The share of obligation-and-audience pairs a page tells. `null` when the run stood outside a checkout and had no corpus to state the obligations.

Style findings per hundred thousand words of prose. The metric table states the rate per THOUSAND words; the unit here is a hundred times finer so the number is an exact integer, and a reader divides by a hundred to get the table's own unit. The reason is not taste: every schema in this project is free of floats, and the first float takes the `Eq` floor off every generated type — a cost this row is not worth paying. `null` when the package ships no banned list for its own language, which is the state where a zero would mean «nothing to find one with».
`docs:` lines of severity P1 in the host's `BACKLOG.md`. The target is zero and the other severities live in the queue's own section.

Journal entries whose «→ regulation» field is still empty. The metric table counts entries and decisions; one number says the same thing, because the target is that every entry has one. `null` when the package carries no journal.
Days since the last full reconciliation, from the date `reviews.toml` records. `null` when none has happened.
One source of queue rows.
Whether this run asked the question. A section that was skipped carries no items and says so here.

Where a row came from (`MAINTENANCE.md` §3). Closed: the queue's sources are the signals the regulation names, and a ninth would be a change to the regulation rather than a value a run may invent. `version-change` appears only when `maintenance/surface/` holds a snapshot of some version other than the package's own — then it carries the output of `vibe doc diff` (`MAINTENANCE.md` §2.5).
One row of the queue: what needs attention and why.
The page, the address or the debt line the row is about.
Why it is in the queue, in one line an author can act on without opening anything else.

How loud the row is. An `error` is something the documentation promises and does not do; a `warning` is prose somebody should look at; `info` is a row that is here to be counted, such as a debt line already triaged elsewhere.
